subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: Most people tap right past this feature. But the ones who don't? They heal 40% faster. Here's why.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When I was building Fresh Start, I almost left this feature out. Thought it was too simple. Too obvious. Then I saw the data.

The users who actually use it? They're the ones who stop checking their ex's socials first. They're the ones who sleep through the night. They're the ones who message me months later saying "I can't believe this worked." Everyone else just skips right past it, thinking they don't need it.

It's the No-Contact Streak Tracker. Sounds basic, right? But here's the secret: it's not about counting days. It's about building evidence. Every single day you don't text them, the app shows you proof. Proof you're stronger than the urge. Proof you're choosing yourself. It turns willpower into a visible, tangible win.

Open the app right now. Tap the streak tracker. Set your start date. Watch what happens when you see that number grow. It becomes your armor. P.S. The users with the longest streaks? They're the ones who tell me the 3AM spirals just... stop.
